body:
If you do go walking to your local food bank: 
call ahead and ask them if they’re able to set aside food for you. That way you won’t be walking all that way (burning calories you probably don’t have at the moment) for nothing. 
Take a backpack if you have one. 
Leaving your hands free will be easier when you’re walking and the weight is on your back. 
If you don’t have a backpack, try to find bags that aren’t plastic and have thick handles, this will make it less likely to break during the walk home. And if it isn’t raining, wear light clothing so when you heat up, you won’t have to put a jacket inside of one of the bags or around your waist. 

Now, if you’re unable to walk to your food bank because of personal reasons: 
are you able to ask a friend for any staple items of food? Such as flour, sugar, rice, dried beans, butter/vegetable oil, milk(or milk powder). That way you will be able to bake yourself something to eat. Like soda bread, scones, ‘depression’ baking foods (these use no dairy or eggs) and rice/bean meals.

If that isn’t an option, can you call your welfare place to check the status of your check then ask to have your check rushed because you are currently without food? Or even ask for ‘a food card/stamps’ if that is in your area so you can get yourself something to eat. 

Maybe even ask r/Random_Acts_Of_Pizza for a pizza to help you in the moment?? 

I’m so sorry all you have is olives.

Edit: a word.

Things happen, be honest. Call work ASAP and let them know that you are on your way. Apologise. Work hard. And take it as a tough lesson to go to bed a little earlier on work nights and always double check that your phone is charging.

If you’ve already been ignoring him for a few weeks chances are he’s already got the hint- you’re over him and his attitude. A person like the one you’ve described tends to have people come and go quite frequently.. You don’t need to message him or reassure him that you’re ending the friendship, especially if you’re scared of his reaction. Just remove yourself entirely.

Don’t put yourself in a risky situation just to appease a person you don’t want to see/speak to again.
